semiconductor_relevance: High — VON ARDENNE specializes in deposition solutions and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in advanced packaging and MEMS applications.
summary: VON ARDENNE GmbH is a leading provider of high-precision deposition equipment and services tailored for the semiconductor industry. They leverage their expertise in vacuum technology and materials science to deliver custom solutions that meet the evolving needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Advanced deposition equipment for MEMS and piezoMEMS
Ion beam etching and electron beam evaporation
Magnetron sputtering for precise surface processing
